description: This file defines the Address entity class used in the customer module of the shopping application. It contains fields for address details such as name, company, contact info, and geographical data, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer's address with validation annotations, getter, and setter methods.

methods.name: setStateProvince
methods.description: Sets the state or province of the address.

methods.name: setCountry
methods.description: Sets the country code for the address.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name associated with the address.

methods.name: setCompany
methods.description: Sets the company name associated with the address.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city of the address.

methods.name: setCity
methods.description: Sets the city of the address.

methods.name: isBillingAddress
methods.description: Checks if the address is a billing address.

methods.name: setBillingAddress
methods.description: Marks the address as billing address or not.

methods.name: getBilstateOther
methods.description: Returns additional state info, if any.
